name: maket
description: Visual design tool for Claude — compose posters, flyers, labels, social posts with PDF export
author: Alexandre Boyer

scripts.dev: MAKET_PORT=${MAKET_PORT:-24843} MAKET_DATA_DIR="$PWD/.maket" npx tsx --watch packages/server/index.ts & MAKET_PORT=${MAKET_PORT:-24843} npm run dev -w @maket/client & wait
scripts.dev:watch: MAKET_PORT=${MAKET_PORT:-24843} MAKET_DATA_DIR="$PWD/.maket" npx tsx --watch packages/server/index.ts & MAKET_PORT=${MAKET_PORT:-24843} npm run build -w @maket/client -- --watch & wait
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:client && npm run test:e2e -w @maket/client
scripts.e2e:server: rm -rf .e2e-maket && MAKET_PORT=3399 MAKET_DATA_DIR="$PWD/.e2e-maket" npx tsx packages/server/index.ts
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
